summary: The root QML refers to small, destructive insects. It can mean a kind of weevil or woodworm (سُوسٌ), or a type of tick (قُرَاد). The term قُمَّلٌ specifically denotes these tiny pests.
lane: قُمَّلٌ ذ i. q. سُوسٌ : or a kind of قُرَاد . (Jel, vii. 130.) See سَاسَ .
